mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SM.COMPANY_CODE AS companyCode ,SM.DIVISION_CODE AS divisionCode ,SM.CUSTOMER_CODE AS customerCode FROM SALES_MST SM WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{p.companyCode} AND SM.INVOICE_DATE LIKE #{p.yyyymmdd} || '%' AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'D' AND SM.VIRTUAL_YN = 'N' AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.divisionCode}, SM.DIVISION_CODE) AND SM.CUSTOMER_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.customerCode}, SM.CUSTOMER_CODE) AND SM.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.deliveryCustomerCode}, SM.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE) ORDER BY SM.DIVISION_CODE, SM.CUSTOMER_CODE
